def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = case['required_symbols']
    # Build id->node dict
    node_by_id = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    # Retained set
    retained = set(node_by_id.keys())
    # Build children list per node (map id to list of child ids)
    children_map = {}
    for n in nodes:
        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children_map.setdefault(pid, []).append(n['id'])
    # Sort nodes by depth descending, then by id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    removed = []
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        # conditions
        if node['parent'] is None:  # root
            continue
        if node['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # check retained children
        child_ids = children_map.get(nid, [])
        if any(cid in retained for cid in child_ids):
            continue
        # try removal
        retained.remove(nid)
        # check required symbols still present
        if not all(any(node_by_id[cid]['symbol'] == req and cid in retained for cid in node_by_id) for req in required_symbols):
            retained.add(nid)
            continue
        removed.append(nid)
    retained_ids = sorted(retained)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed, "retained_node_ids": retained_ids}
